notes: Entries revision: posted entries of the current year (AC_BASIC.CURRENT_YEAR) when entries revision is switched on (AC_BASIC.REV_FLAG = 1); only the 'reviewed' flag REV1 can be changed (both menu entries: revision and cancel revision). See processes/AC_YEARLY_REV.md

rules.where: ENTRY_YEAR = (select current_year from ac_basic where company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and nvl(rev_flag, 0) = 1)

AC_YEARLY_TRN.POST_SYSTEM.lov: select case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(system_desc_e, system_desc_a) else system_desc_a end d, system_number r from sys_systems where system_number not in (0, 99) order by system_number
